name: Outside-app integration (heca-pro): serve CLI, v1 read API, entity events, per-session focus
description:
Request from heca-pro (~/projects/heca-pro/docs/agent-plan-work.md), agreed with the user 2026-09-29. heca-pro bundles agent-plan and drives it from a Node helper; it shows a read-only planner view and links to the web UI for editing. Agents write through MCP. Assignment/roles stay out of agent-plan.

Current state: the agent-plan CLI (packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts) has init/mcp/guard/export but no serve; plan-server starts only from code or env vars PLAN_PORT/PLAN_HOST/PLAN_ROOT (packages/plan-server/src/cli.ts). The ~60 routes in packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts are the web UI's own backend, unversioned. /ws (packages/plan-server/src/ws-hub.ts:12-19) sends whole-collection events (features-updated, phases-updated). The deviation stack (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:168) and resume focus are per project; task ownership is already per session (activeOwnerSession, task-selection.ts:263). `agent-plan init <name> --yes` (index.ts:102) sets only the name and exits silently if a planner exists.

Goals: (1) `agent-plan serve` with root/port/host options, prints address, --json. (2) Separate read-only /api/v1 with documented contract, apiVersion in responses, shared response types in plan-core AND a pinned-shape test; web UI routes untouched; new module, not more code in serve.ts. (3) `entity-changed` WS event {apiVersion, kind, ref, id, op, parent refs}; old events stay for the web UI. (4) Deviation stack and resume focus keyed per session; sessionless callers keep project-wide behaviour. (5) init gains --description, --goal, --json and a distinct documented already-exists result.

Already done, not part of this feature: heca-pro's cascade feature-delete bug (feature survived a delete) is fixed by commit 840db0c with its own test; it reaches heca-pro in the next release (they run 0.3.2).

Behaviours to preserve: the web UI backend and its X-Planner-Source rules; existing /ws events; planner disabled by default (heca-pro never starts the server on its own); harness-agnostic core (AGENTS.md rule 4). Contract types live in plan-core and are also exported for plan-server.

Order: phase P110 (serve + init), then P111 (read API + events), then P112 (per-session focus).
